errors.text_span: beyond their sequence in the legend
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies a relationship between the order of categories on the x-axis ('Movies', 'Songs', 'Basketball') and the sequence of items in the legend ('Llama3', 'Qwen2', 'ChatGPT'). The order of categories on the axis is independent of the legend's content.

The chart is a grouped bar chart, where bars for Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT are clustered together for each category (Movies, Songs, Basketball). The description incorrectly states that the bars are not grouped.

errors.text_span: This bar chart, titled “Proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT,”
errors.evidence: The figure does not have a title. The text used as the title is from the external caption provided with the image, not part of the chart itself.

errors.text_span: compares the performance of three large language models
errors.evidence: The prompt instructs to avoid interpretation. The y-axis is labeled "Ratio (%)", not "Performance". Describing the chart as comparing "performance" is an inference about what the ratio represents.

errors.text_span: the Qwen2 bar is also at approximately 90%
errors.evidence: In the "Movies" category, the red bar for Qwen2 is visibly taller than the 90% line. Stating it is "at approximately 90%" is an underestimate and loses the distinction that it is the highest value on the chart.
